budget_formula: Same 1800-second arm budget as prior paired diagnostics; each arm replays 4 recorded prefixes to T then continues at most 30 more actions / 250s per fork.
comparison_note: Same four official games, same fork states, same extra budget. A continues fresh from T; B gets one host evidence recheck as an opening message. Full-trajectory (prefix + continuation) run records; no new tool API, no FP8. Public-development scores, not hidden leaderboard.
game_source: The four recorded failure prefixes (017 local evidence); frozen and reserve games are not mounted.
purpose: At identical recorded failure states, test whether a host evidence recheck helps the model recover clearance versus continuing fresh
selection_note: A gain counts only if B changes subsequent actions versus A from the same fork and completes the level or advances further within the shared extra budget, without false alarms on the r11l control. Do not submit from this run.
